shortDescription: SSC Exam Calendar 2026-27 released – tentative schedule for CGL, CHSL, MTS, JE, CPO, GD and more at ssc.gov.in.
content:
The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published the Tentative Calendar of Examinations for 2026–2027.

It includes advertisement dates, closing dates and month of examination for major exams such as CGL, CHSL, MTS, JE, CPO (SI), GD Constable, Stenographer and Selection Posts, plus limited departmental exams.

Download only from ssc.gov.in. Dates remain tentative until the detailed notice for each exam is issued.
